message: Hi, my kid Mia is 10 and wants to try jiu jitsu. Do you have classes for that age?

Hey! Yes, we do! We have a Kids Jiu-Jitsu class for ages 7-13 that would be perfect for Mia. It's no-gi Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu and great for kids her age. Would you like to book a free trial class for her?
Yes, I’d love to book a free trial class for Mia! What time slots do you have available?
Perfect! I just need a few quick details to get your trial set up. What's your name?
Great, thanks Tester! And what's the best email to send the trial details to?
You can send the details to tester.harbor@gmail.com.
Perfect! And what's the best phone number to reach you at?
Got it! Now I just need Mia's full name and date of birth to get her trial class set up.
Mia Harbor, and her birthday is March 11, 2016.

Perfect! Mia is all set for the Kids 7-13 class.
Here are some available times for her free trial:

- Today Monday 7/6 at 6:00 PM
- Tuesday 7/7 at 6:00 PM
- Wednesday 7/8 at 6:00 PM

Which works best for you?
Let's go with today, Monday 7/6 at 6:00 PM. Thanks!
Awesome! Mia is booked for her free trial today, Monday 7/6 at 6:00 PM. We'll send the details to tester.harbor@gmail.com. Just bring comfortable workout clothes and water. See you soon!
